ecommerce-dashboard.reason: X has a warm dark theme with serif candle names, 'No. 01' numbering and a rust/olive palette that feels like a candle brand, not an admin template. The headline chart with a dashed previous-period line and the 'Running low' list with days-left bars and Out in 2 days badges put the key tasks first. Y is clean and competent but reads as a generic light SaaS dashboard with identical white cards.
winner_weaknesses: Dense dark UI with small, low-key grey meta text (sell rates, subtitles) and a lot of tiny badges; olive-on-dark contrast is borderline in places
Desktop layout leaves a large empty area under the chart beside the tall Running low column, and the 'View as table' link is orphaned

manipulative_patterns.X: none (urgency badges are factual stock-out estimates)

settings-form.reason: Y groups each section in a card with a footer action bar ('All changes saved' + Save changes) and a sticky left section nav, so it reads as a polished Linear-style product. It adds useful detail: live local time under the timezone, a 3-segment password strength meter, a segmented digest-frequency control and the 'Security emails are always sent' note. X is tidy but is a long single scroll of plain two-column rows, and its tabs are not tied to the page structure.
winner_weaknesses: On phone the digest frequency buttons wrap awkwardly (Monthly orphaned on its own row) and the tabs row is tight
Heavy card stacking with dark-on-dark surfaces and small grey helper text gives low depth contrast; the Save button is outline-only so the primary action is weak

mobile-booking.reason: X has real barbershop character: the red and blue barber-pole stripe at the top, brick-red accent, horizontal barber chips with avatars and ratings, and a sticky summary bar showing 'Today at 10:30 / Haircut with Marcus / 28 pounds' beside the CTA. The tinted selected state and clear step counters make progress easy to follow. Y is clear and usable but generic green booking-template styling, with a tall vertical barber list that pushes time selection far down.
winner_weaknesses: Morning slots wrap with an orphaned 11:30 and the afternoon grid has a lone 16:30, and the barber carousel clips the fourth barber with no scroll cue
Selected service has a pink fill with a red border that borders on error styling; the whole page is long with 20+ equal-weight time buttons

manipulative_patterns.X: none (a pre-selected 10:30 and haircut default is mildly presumptive but not deceptive)
manipulative_patterns.Y: none (pre-selected Skin fade, the pricier option, and Marcus is a mild default nudge)
